title: NVIDIA Q1 FY2027 Earnings
thesisImpact: Blackwell Ultra ramp confirmation is the single biggest near-term signal for the entire AI power supply chain. A beat + forward guidance upgrade accelerates datacenter power procurement timelines at every hyperscaler.

title: NRC Advanced Reactor Design Review: Oklo Aurora 15 MW Decision
thesisImpact: A full design approval for Oklo's Aurora microreactor would be the first commercial fast spectrum reactor certification in US history. Unlocks tech-company direct ownership of on-site nuclear power plants.

title: Constellation Energy Q1 2026 Earnings + Nuclear PPA Update
thesisImpact: CEG will disclose progress on Three Mile Island restart timeline and any new hyperscaler nuclear offtake negotiations. Watch for Meta 6.6 GW RFP bid disclosure; a win would be transformative.

title: Eaton Corporation Q1 2026 Earnings
thesisImpact: Eaton's electrical segment is the single best bellwether for datacenter power hardware demand. Order intake for switchgear, PDUs, and transformer systems directly reflects hyperscaler capex deployment pace. Backlog guidance is the key number.

title: IRS Section 45U Nuclear Production Tax Credit Final Rules
thesisImpact: The IRA's $15/MWh nuclear production tax credit final implementation rules determine the economic viability of existing nuclear fleet restarts and new SMR projects. Strong rules significantly lower the cost of power for hyperscaler PPAs.

title: GE Vernova Q1 2026 Earnings
thesisImpact: GEV's gas turbine and grid equipment order book is the clearest signal of utility-scale power infrastructure spend. Transformer lead times (currently 4+ years) and turbine backlog reveal how tight the supply chain actually is.

title: MISO 2026/2027 Planning Year Capacity Auction Results
thesisImpact: MISO's most constrained auction in years. Clearing prices directly determine merchant power profitability across the Midwest grid, which serves the largest concentration of US hyperscaler datacenters. A price spike confirms the grid stress thesis.

title: Cameco Q1 2026 Earnings + Uranium Market Update
thesisImpact: CCJ's commentary on utility contracting activity, Cigar Lake production, and Kazakh import risk sets the tone for the entire uranium sector. Any mention of new long-term contract signings tied to nuclear restarts is a direct thesis accelerator.

title: Uranium Spot Contracting Window Opens: Utility Long-Term Book Build
thesisImpact: US and European utilities typically open 3-5 year uranium supply contracts in Q2. If AI-driven nuclear restarts accelerate new contracting, supply tightness pushes uranium spot above $100/lb, catalyzing CCJ and NXE significantly.

title: DOE National Transmission Planning Study: Grid Capacity Buildout Roadmap
thesisImpact: The DOE's quadrennial grid study sets the federal investment framework for transmission expansion. AI datacenter load growth has made this the highest-stakes energy planning document since the 1970s oil crisis.

title: PJM 2026/2027 Capacity Auction Results
thesisImpact: PJM serves the largest electricity market in North America. After record 2025 clearing prices ($270/MW-day), the 2026 auction will reveal whether new supply is coming online fast enough to meet AI-driven load additions. A second consecutive price spike would be a watershed moment for merchant power stocks.

title: FERC Order 1920 Regional Transmission Planning: First Filing Deadline
thesisImpact: Order 1920 mandates long-range transmission planning for the first time in a decade. Regional utilities must file 20-year transmission expansion plans aligned with projected load growth. Strong filings that acknowledge AI datacenter demand unlock hundreds of billions in grid infrastructure spend.

title: Constellation Energy Q2 2026 Earnings
thesisImpact: Six months into the post-Crane restart, CEG will update on output and any new PPA signings. The critical question: has the Meta 6.6 GW RFP been awarded? Any nuclear capacity announcement tied to an AI customer is a re-rating event for the entire nuclear utility sector.

title: Vistra Corp Q2 2026 Earnings
thesisImpact: VST is the largest competitive power generator in the US, with 41 GW of capacity. Q2 commentary on forward power prices, retail electricity margins, and any new hyperscaler power contracts is a direct read on merchant power fundamentals.

title: DOE Loan Programs Office: Advanced Nuclear SMR Awards
thesisImpact: The DOE LPO has $20B+ in conditional loan commitments for advanced nuclear. Final award decisions for TerraPower, X-energy, and Kairos Power projects would provide non-dilutive capital that unlocks private co-investment. Directly de-risks the SMR development timeline by 2-3 years.

title: NVIDIA Q2 FY2027 Earnings
thesisImpact: The first full quarter of Blackwell Ultra (B300) volume shipments. Revenue per GPU and rack-level power draw are the two most important numbers. Rising power density per rack (now 120 kW) is the central mechanical driver of datacenter power procurement acceleration.

title: NRC Kairos Power FluoRi-20 Construction Permit Decision
thesisImpact: If approved, this would be the first fluoride salt-cooled reactor construction permit in US history. Google has contracted output from this facility. An NRC approval would validate the entire non-light-water reactor regulatory pathway and accelerate tech-company nuclear procurement strategies.
